base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT T2.XCL_010, T3.AVG_SCORE
FROM (
    SELECT T1.XCL_001, SUM(T1.XCL_006) AS TOTAL_REV
    FROM XTB_001 T1
    GROUP BY T1.XCL_001
    ORDER BY TOTAL_REV ASC
    LIMIT 1
) T_MIN
JOIN XTB_002 T2 ON T_MIN.XCL_001 = T2.XCL_009
JOIN (
    SELECT XCL_013, AVG(XCL_015) AS AVG_SCORE
    FROM XTB_003
    GROUP BY XCL_013
) T3 ON T2.XCL_010 = T3.XCL_013
